summary:
Frontend-only E2E test of the FOUR new features in this iteration (Path highlight on neighborhood, Evidence pinning, Source onboarding, View export/import) plus regression on prior flows. All four features work end-to-end against the real EOIP backend. ONE non-blocking bug found: the Source Onboarding modal does NOT pre-fill the Base URL field for the 'web' connector (it is initialized to empty string in SourceOnboarding.tsx:25), which contradicts the task spec stating 'fields onboard-source-id, onboard-name, onboard-base-url are pre-filled'. When Base URL is left empty, POST /sources returns 422 'Validation failed' and the wizard shows a red error. After the tester typed https://example.com into the Base URL field, the full wizard succeeded (create → step 3 'registered' → baseline → QUEUED SOURCE_OPERATION job id ff1c47bc-... → Done → new source listed in Registered sources).

PATH HIGHLIGHT (/graph → Impact paths): Selecting source=EOIP-1 and target=service.py returned 3 shortest paths of 4 hops each (EOIP-1 → README.md|42 → 3d9ab57f-... → service.py). The paths-list panel renders each path's hop sequence as chips, the stats chip shows '3 paths' in cyan, and the canvas renders the merged neighborhood with path nodes enlarged/brightly colored (demo blue, 42 cyan, README.md green, META grey, service.py cyan) and path edges in bright cyan while the surrounding context Branch cluster (dozens of grey nodes) is clearly dimmed and context edges are hair-thin grey (verified via screenshot /app/.screenshots/paths_highlight.png). Switching back to graph-mode-explore clears the paths-list, removes PATH edges, and returns to the normal neighborhood. (Dimming is implemented via sigma.js canvas node/edge color + size attributes in GraphCanvas.tsx:134-163, so DOM opacity queries cannot measure it; visual verification is the correct method.)

EVIDENCE PINNING (/ask): Running the deterministic query 'What implements EOIP-1?' rendered 4 evidence items each with a visible pin button (ask-evidence-pin-0..3). Clicking ask-evidence-pin-0 opens the right-side pins-panel (titled 'EVIDENCE BOARD (1)') and the top-bar pins-trigger shows badge '1'. Clicking ask-evidence-pin-1 increments the badge to '2' and the panel to 'EVIDENCE BOARD (2)'. The panel contains pins-copy, pins-export, pins-clear buttons, and each pin has an X remove button (6 svg-buttons in panel = 3 header + 2 pin X + Clear). pins-export downloads a JSON file with schema {kind:'kgf.evidence', version:1, pins:[{text,...}]}. Toggling pins-trigger closes then reopens the panel. Pins persist after navigating to /overview (badge remains '2').

SOURCE ONBOARDING (/ingestion → Sources): Clicking connector-web opens source-onboarding modal. Step 1 fields: onboard-source-id='web-1' prefilled, onboard-name='Web Crawler Source' prefilled, onboard-base-url=EMPTY (BUG — should be prefilled). After editing source id to unique 'web-test-714348' and manually filling base URL, onboard-next advances to Step 2 review; onboard-create POSTs /sources (200) and transitions to Step 3 showing 'Source web-test-714348 registered.'; onboard-baseline POSTs /sources/{id}/baseline (202) and shows a QUEUED job chip with job id 'ff1c47bc-07a1-4184-9b03-13a47d9f2c72' and 'Baseline started. Track progress in the Jobs tab.'; onboard-done closes the modal; after ingestion-refresh the new 'Web Crawler Source / web-test-714348' appears in the Registered sources list alongside the existing 'demo-web-1'.

VIEW SHARING (/graph → Views): Saving a view ('TEST_export_view') then clicking graph-view-export triggered a JSON download with structure {kind:'kgf.views', version:1, views:[...]} (verified by parsing). graph-view-import is a <label> containing a hidden <input type=file accept='application/json'> labeled 'Import'. The footnote reads 'Saved on this device only. Export to share with teammates.' — matches spec exactly.

REGRESSION: sign-in w/ pre-filled bearer + Continue button works; overview stats 226 vertices / 721 edges / 0.0142 density / 75 vertex labels / 68 edge labels render; app-shell-nav routing to overview/ask/graph/ingestion/schema works; global-search-trigger and theme-toggle-button present.

ui_bugs.issue: onboard-base-url input is NOT pre-filled (initialized to empty string at line 25: `const [baseUrl, setBaseUrl] = useState('')`). Clicking onboard-next → onboard-create with empty base_url makes POST /sources return 422 'Validation failed' for the 'web' connector. The task spec requires base URL to be pre-filled alongside source-id and name. Suggested fix: initialize baseUrl from connector-type-specific defaults (e.g., 'https://example.com' for web, '' acceptable for non-URL connectors) OR disable onboard-next until base URL is provided for connector types that require it, OR make base URL optional on the backend for the web connector.

action_items: Pre-fill onboard-base-url for connectors that need a URL (at minimum for 'web' connector) OR add client-side validation that blocks onboard-next with a helpful message instead of letting /sources POST return 422 at step 2.
critical_code_review_comments: SourceOnboarding.tsx: `onDone()` is called BEFORE `setStep(3)` in create() (line 44-45), and also inside runBaseline() even on success — fine functionally but mixing step transition with parent callback order is confusing. Also `base_url: baseUrl.trim() || undefined` sends undefined to backend, which the backend rejects (422) for the 'web' source type; worth validating earlier in the wizard.

GraphExplorer.tsx: path highlight correctly merges endpoint neighborhoods + path edges and clears PATH edges on mode switch — good. runPaths runs 3 parallel requests via Promise.all and gracefully falls back to empty neighborhoods on individual failures.

GraphCanvas decoration effect (lines 127-166) mutates sigma node/edge attributes imperatively — this is correct for sigma but makes DOM-based testing of dimming impossible; adding an aria-live summary or data-attribute on the container indicating 'highlight-mode: paths' with path node count would help automated verification.

success_rate.frontend: 4/4 features verified; 1 UI bug (base_url not prefilled) requires manual workaround

seed_data_creation: Created one Source via /sources: id='web-test-714348' (type=web, name='Web Crawler Source', base_url='https://example.com'), plus one baseline job 'ff1c47bc-07a1-4184-9b03-13a47d9f2c72'. Also saved one view 'TEST_export_view' in localStorage. These should be cleaned up before re-running the onboarding test or the test will use a new random id (test already uses `web-test-<random>`).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features in this iteration verified. Only functional issue: onboard-base-url not prefilled for 'web' connector — tests must manually fill it (e.g., 'https://example.com') or the create step 422s. Pin buttons (ask-evidence-pin-N) are visible without hovering (always rendered in current build, no need for .hover()). Pins export schema: {kind:'kgf.evidence', version:1, pins:[{text,...}]}. Views export schema: {kind:'kgf.views', version:1, views:[...]}. Path highlight dimming is sigma-canvas rendered — verify via screenshot, not DOM opacity. Signed-in session is in-memory only — always use app-shell-nav-* clicks, never page.goto() to authed routes. 2–3 console 401 errors on /signin are expected (auth verify-then-fallback).
rca of the issue: SourceOnboarding modal — base URL field: In /app/frontend/src/components/SourceOnboarding.tsx line 25, `useState('')` leaves baseUrl empty. On submit (line 40) `base_url: baseUrl.trim() || undefined` sends no base_url. The backend validator for source_type='web' requires a non-empty base_url (returns HTTP 422 'Validation failed'). Reproduction: /ingestion → Sources tab → click Web Crawler card → Step 1 shows source-id prefilled, name prefilled, Base URL EMPTY → Next → Review → Register source → 422. Mitigation: either (a) make baseUrl default to a sensible value (e.g., `${connector.id === 'web' ? 'https://example.com' : ''}`), (b) require Base URL at step 1 for connector types where backend demands it, OR (c) surface the 422 with field-level error on Base URL instead of a generic 'Validation failed' chip.
